label: Political Money

notes.note: T1: overlay checked; three red parts, connector ends, lid stubs and slot match

corrections.what: Drew the coin as a true circle (centre 45.1, 59.85, r 34.7) and centred the dollar sign in it
corrections.why: DR-03 true circles. A circle fits the coin with 0.18 px rms; the dollar sign's centre measures (45.3, 59.7), 0.2 px off the coin's.

corrections.what: Built the dollar sign's S from two equal tangent bowls (r 7.3), point-symmetric, with stem stubs above and below
corrections.why: DR-03. Bowl fits give 7.0 to 7.2 px (top) and 7.2 to 7.55 px (bottom); the ends sit 18 deg past horizontal at opposite corners.

corrections.what: Gave both connector bends one radius, 8.9 px
corrections.why: DR-03 one consistent corner. They measure 9.23 px (lower) and about 8.5 px (upper).

corrections.what: Gave the lid slants one slope, 58.45 deg, rising from the front's top corners to one height, y 36.4; each keeps its drawn short top stub (4.43 px left, 2.5 px right)
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. The slants measure 57.9 and 59.0 deg. The stub ends stay within 0.5 px of the sheet.

corrections.what: Levelled the slot line at y 44.1
corrections.why: DR-03 straight lines. It tilts 1.5 deg on the sheet.

corrections.what: Drew every stroke at the set line weight W, 5.5 px
corrections.why: DR-03 one line weight. The dollar sign and the ballot's red edges measure 5.9 to 6.2 px; the rest 5.25 to 5.75 px.

source_notes: Kept: the connector as a plain path without an arrowhead, leaving the coin's right side at y 62.4, rising at x 104.07 and entering the ballot at y 24.45; the ballot's long edges parallel (both measure 53.1 deg) with its 84.5 deg top-left corner as drawn; the slot running 7 px past the ballot's lower right; the open lid with short stubs. Red follows the red sheet in three separate parts: the dollar sign; the connector, which ends at the black left edge of the ballot (drawn first, so the coin ring and that edge lie over its ends); and the ballot's top edge plus the upper part of its right edge down to y 37.6, where it is cut square and the right edge continues black to the slot. The ballot's left edge and the box stay black.
